answers.core: For the same reason `RayCast` node is in core and not in the asset library, the existing PhysicsDirectSpaceState API is useful but too complex to use in an optimal way.
answers.workaround: No, it requires making a tool script that can handle all the set up data and visualization which can be quite complex for average users.

title: Replace RayCast node with a generic ShapeCast node that cover more options
